title: Developing county-owned land for affordable housing
summary: On June 15, 2025's meeting record shows the housing department plans to study a South Kīhei parcel of over 100 acres, called the Kīhei Police Station parcel, and will share its list of county properties targeted for housing. In April, planning sought consultant money to get county land approved for housing, working with the Department of Housing, after last year's funded work was not done. Housing has said a large Kīhei county parcel is high on its affordable housing priority list.
